subject.title: feat(memorySearch): Support multimodal embedding with gemini-embedding-2-preview

question: Should OpenClaw expand Gemini multimodal memory beyond opt-in `extraPaths` image/audio into session attachments plus PDF/video, and what consent, retention, provider-upload, and reindex contract should gate it?
rationale: The missing behavior is feasible in the current provider path, but it changes how user media is uploaded to remote embedding providers and retained in searchable memory, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product/security boundary.

options.title: Design gated media memory first
options.body: Define supported modalities, opt-in consent, retention/redaction behavior, provider limits, and reindex/index-identity behavior before implementation work.

options.title: Limit core to shipped subset
options.body: Keep core at image/audio files under `memorySearch.extraPaths` and close or redirect attachment/PDF/video work until maintainers sponsor the broader boundary.

options.title: Expand `extraPaths` only
options.body: Add PDF/video only for explicitly configured `extraPaths` while excluding chat attachment retention for now.

recommendation.title: Design gated media memory first
recommendation.body: Define supported modalities, opt-in consent, retention/redaction behavior, provider limits, and reindex/index-identity behavior before implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the shipped multimodal memory subset and the closest config/docs boundary that the remaining decision would extend.
